Shortly after we were robbed in San Francisco earlier this year, we happened across a hacker and maker space known as Noisebridge. The space is open to the public, maintained as a non-profit working space, and has tools and teaching for 3D printing, laser cutters, CNCs, woodshop tools, knitting and sewing tools, and more. We learned about meshnet and meshcore decentralized networking, hacking hardware, and just doing cool things with technology while visiting.

Visit Noisebridge at 272 Capp St, San Francisco, CA 94110. Their website is here: https://www.noisebridge.net/wiki
They also accept donations: https://www.noisebridge.net/wiki/Donate_or_Pay_Dues

The best way to support our work is through our store: https://store.gamersnexus.net/
